name: omajam
author: Nathan Ollerenshaw (matjam)
description: A full MPD client for the Omarchy bar. The queue, the library, stored playlists and search in one keyboard-driven window styled after rmpc, with what is playing in the bar beside it. Talks the MPD protocol directly over TCP or a unix socket, so state arrives as the server pushes it rather than on a poll.

barWidget.description: Now playing from MPD, with transport controls and cover art. Click it for the full client: queue, library browser, playlists and search, with rmpc's keybindings.

schema.label: MPD host
schema.description: Hostname or IP. A path or an @name is a unix socket. Empty follows $MPD_HOST, then 127.0.0.1.

schema.label: MPD port
schema.description: Ignored when the host is a unix socket.

schema.label: MPD password
schema.description: Only if the server asks for one. Stored as plain text in shell.json.

schema.label: Label format
schema.description: %tag% substitutes, [ ] drops the group when a tag inside is missing, [a|b] takes the first that resolves.

schema.label: Label width (pixels)
schema.description: How much room the label may take before it scrolls or elides.

schema.label: When the label is too long
Playback controls
schema.description: Previous, play/pause and next in the bar.

schema.label: Controls placement
schema.description: left puts them before the label, right after it.

schema.label: Cover thumbnail in the bar
schema.description: The hover card always shows the cover; this adds a small one to the bar.

schema.label: Settings button
schema.description: Off leaves right-click on the label as the way into the panel.

schema.label: When nothing is playing
schema.description: icon keeps a glyph in the bar, hide removes the widget entirely.

schema.label: Notify on track change
schema.description: A desktop notification with the cover when the track changes.
